scenes.conflict: Her relatives hide the worst entries and press her to keep quiet, while the Guild's deadline to cut the light draws near.
scenes.goal: Learn the true extent of House Veyra's debt to the Lamp Guild.
scenes.outcome: Isolde confirms the house cannot repay and resolves to restructure the debt secretly before the light is cut.
scenes.summary: In the Terraces, Isolde audits House Veyra's books and confirms that the debt to the Lamp Guild is far deeper than her relatives admit. She also finds her relatives plan to buy Bell Warden loyalty by illicit means.
scenes.title: The Ledger of Ruin

scenes.conflict: Dray holds all the leverage and measures everything in profit. He cannot imagine her motives beyond it.
scenes.goal: Isolde wants to restructure the debt on terms that spare her family's oaths.
scenes.outcome: Dray refuses and sets a deadline, after which the Terraces will be dimmed. Isolde leaves determined to find a flaw in his contracts.
scenes.summary: Isolde goes to the Nave to negotiate with Marcus Dray. He courteously prices every concession in hours of light and demands that House Veyra surrender its oaths.
scenes.title: The Price of Light

scenes.conflict: Seraphine will not name her real asset and keeps bargaining. Isolde trusts written records over charming talkers and cannot read her.
scenes.goal: Isolde wants information on Dray's plan to place loyalists among the Wardens, and Seraphine wants to sell it at a profit.
scenes.outcome: Isolde learns Dray is buying Seraphine's debts and that the Wardens' records in the crypt hold a secret. She decides to reach the Wardens.
scenes.summary: Seraphine Voss approaches Isolde among the stalls and hints that she knows something about the Night of the Silent Bell. She sells Isolde a first piece of information about Dray's plans for the Wardens.
scenes.title: A Broker in the Stalls

scenes.conflict: Seraphine will sell what she knows to any bidder, and Isolde's relatives are watching her.
scenes.goal: Confirm the family's illicit scheme and keep it from the Guild.
scenes.outcome: Isolde discovers the bribe would expose House Veyra to ruin and decides to seek Oren Tallow directly.
scenes.summary: Isolde and Seraphine use tapping codes to trade messages across the acoustic halls. They learn Isolde's relatives are arranging an illicit bribe of the Wardens.
scenes.title: Tapping in the Terraces

scenes.conflict: Oren is secretive to the point of paralysis. The senior Wardens watch him and any visitor to the crypt is suspect.
scenes.goal: Isolde wants Oren's help to block Guild and House influence over the Wardens, and Oren wants to know who silenced the bell.
scenes.outcome: Oren shares a single entry in the crypt records suggesting the Silent Bell was deliberately silenced, and Isolde promises to help him find the saboteur.
scenes.summary: Isolde reaches the crypt and meets Oren among the hanging bells. He is wary and silent. He tests her honesty, and she shows him her proof of Dray's plans.
scenes.title: The Acolyte at the Altar

scenes.conflict: His vow of silence conflicts with his growing belief that the Wardens covered up the truth, and lies spoken in the crypt are said to ring the bells out of turn.
scenes.goal: Oren wants a clue to the saboteur's identity.
scenes.outcome: Oren links the Silent Bell to House Veyra's founding charter and decides he must tell Isolde.
scenes.summary: Alone, Oren speaks within the crypt and catches faint answers from the stone. The answers point to the Terrace Charter as the root of the silencing.
scenes.title: When the Stone Answers

scenes.conflict: Her debts leave her dependent on the powers she betrays, and her greed pushes her to bargain further.
scenes.goal: Dray wants an informant inside Isolde's circle, and Seraphine wants to keep her freedom.
scenes.outcome: Seraphine becomes Dray's informant and tells him Isolde has contacted a Warden. He moves against the crypt.
scenes.summary: Dray calls in Seraphine's debts and demands she become a Guild informant against House Veyra and the Wardens. She agrees to feed him partial information while still holding back the Silent Bell secret.
scenes.title: The Guild Tightens Its Hold

scenes.conflict: The proof could destroy House Veyra, and Isolde must choose between loyalty to her house and the truth.
scenes.goal: Isolde and Oren want proof linking the Silent Bell to the Charter.
scenes.outcome: They resolve to expose the truth, but the Guild and her relatives learn of it, and Dray prepares to dim the Terraces.
scenes.summary: Oren breaks the order's silence and visits the Terraces. He and Isolde compare the crypt records with the Terrace Charter and find the Charter rests on a lie about the Silent Bell.
scenes.title: The Charter Under the Ledger

scenes.conflict: Isolde is exposed in the Nave and Seraphine's greed keeps her bargaining when she should walk away.
scenes.goal: Dray wants to force House Veyra's oaths, and Seraphine wants to sell the secret for the best price.
scenes.outcome: Isolde narrowly escapes with her life. Seraphine realizes her bargaining nearly killed her friend, and Dray moves to take the bells.
scenes.summary: Dray dims the Terraces' lamps in the Nave. Seraphine tries to sell the Silent Bell secret to Dray at the highest price, and the bargaining puts Isolde in danger.
scenes.title: The Light Goes Out

scenes.conflict: The senior Wardens watch the crypt, and Seraphine must surrender her main asset.
scenes.goal: Assemble the proof and plan to expose the truth before Dray controls the bells.
scenes.outcome: The three agree to confront Dray and the Wardens together, with the proof in hand.
scenes.summary: Isolde, Oren and Seraphine gather in the crypt. Seraphine gives up her profitable secret to protect Isolde, and they assemble their proof about the Silent Bell and the Charter.
scenes.title: Gathering at the Bells

scenes.conflict: Dray believes everyone acts from profit, and the pressure of the crypt and the bells ringing out of turn threatens everyone present.
scenes.goal: Stop Dray from seizing the bells and force a fairer settlement of oaths and debts.
scenes.outcome: Dray is forced to see that light and air cannot be owned, and he must choose between ruin and sharing power.
scenes.summary: Dray arrives with Guild loyalists to take the bells. Isolde lays out the truth about the Silent Bell and the flawed contracts. Oren breaks his vow and speaks in the crypt, and Dray confronts the fear of being responsible for every breath in the city.
scenes.title: The Confrontation

scenes.conflict: Guild rivals murmur that Dray has overreached, and Isolde must accept the cost of exposing her house's charter.
scenes.goal: Seal a new settlement of oaths and debts that spares House Veyra and limits the Guild's hold.
scenes.outcome: A fairer settlement is sworn, House Veyra keeps its place on reduced terms, and the Guild's power is shared.
scenes.summary: In the Nave, Dray and Isolde agree to restructure the debt and share oversight of the lamps. Seraphine is freed of her debts.
scenes.title: The New Settlement

scenes.conflict: Her relatives resent the exposure of the founding lie and the loss of status.
scenes.goal: Make House Veyra accept a revised Charter.
scenes.outcome: The house accepts a revised Charter with fairer oaths, and Isolde becomes its ledger-keeper and conscience.
scenes.summary: Isolde presents the truth about the Silent Bell to her relatives, and the Terrace Charter is revised. Seraphine, having given up her secret, chooses a modest independent life.
scenes.title: The Charter Revised

scenes.conflict: The senior Wardens resist opening their records, and the stone's rare answers leave questions about the cathedral's origin.
scenes.goal: Oren wants to close the matter of the Silent Bell and restore the Wardens' honor.
scenes.outcome: The Wardens publish the records, Oren is freed from his silence, and the city breathes while the cathedral's deeper mystery remains.
scenes.summary: Oren rings the bells in sequence as the Wardens open their records. He and Isolde stand in the crypt as the cathedral's stone seems to listen.
scenes.title: A Bell Rings True

logline: As the Lamp Guild threatens to cut the light from House Veyra's Terraces and both powers scramble to seize the Bell Wardens, a young ledger-keeper and a silent acolyte uncover the truth of the Silent Bell and must decide whether exposing it will save the drowned city or destroy it.
theme: Light and air cannot be owned, only shared.
title: Abyssal Courts
